Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 28 September 2026 RS Group plc 28 September 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 21 September 2026 to 25 September 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Date of purchase Number of Ordinary Shares purchased Highest price paid per share (pence per share) Lowest price paid per share (pence per share) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share) Venue 21/09/2026 37,940 756.0000 741.0000 752.1736 LSE 22/09/2026 30,754 768.0000 755.5000 763.1789 LSE 23/09/2026 32,866 771.0000 756.0000 763.8555 LSE 24/09/2026 31,678 771.5000 761.5000 767.4586 LSE 25/09/2026 32,153 762.0000 754.0000 759.1960 LSE Since the commencement of this Programme, the Company has purchased 5,211,979 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays Bank plc in accordance with the Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 468,837,489 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 468,837,489. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of the Market Abuse Regulation, a breakdown of the individual trades made by Barclays as principal on behalf of the Company in connection with the above purchases is set out below. Purchases made under the Programme will be announced on a weekly basis.
